description: Manages Huawei Cloud DIS (Data Ingestion Service) full lifecycle: stream channel create/list/show/delete, retention and data-type updates, partition scale-up/scale-down, dump (transfer) tasks to OBS/DWS/DLI/MRS/CloudTable with start/stop/delete, real-time ingestion metrics for streams and partitions, consumer apps, cursors, checkpoints, data upload/consumption verification, stream authorization policies and resource tags. Produces structured inventory and monitoring reports; all mutating operations require explicit user confirmation. Triggers include: "DIS通道管理", "DIS数据接入", "创建DIS通道", "查询DIS通道", "删除DIS通道", "DIS分区扩容", "DIS转储任务", "DIS监控指标", "DIS消费组", "DIS数据上传", "DIS日常巡检", "DIS troubleshooting", "Data Ingestion Service", "DIS stream", "create DIS stream", "DIS dump task", "DIS metrics", "DIS partition scale", "ingest data into DIS".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
